entries.content: Vanus Galerion founded the Mages Guild. Branches operate in every major city. They offer magical supplies and the Spellmaker service.
The Nine Divines oversee the Empire spiritually. The pantheon includes Akatosh Arkay Dibella Julianos Kynareth Mara Stendarr Zenithar and Talos. Worshippers pray for guidance daily.
Temple chapels stand in every city. Priests offer potent healing magic. They cure diseases and bestow divine blessings.
Noble Courts rule local provincial territories. Local lords govern from grand palaces. They offer lucrative bounties regarding dangerous monsters.
City Guards enforce local law strictly. They patrol the streets tirelessly. You can negotiate with them or avoid them entirely.
The Imperial Legion functions as the primary military. They enforce the puppet regime of Jagar Tharn. Their soldiers wear heavy armor.
The Thieves Guild operates in deep shadow. They maintain a presence in most cities. They fence stolen goods and provide lockpicking assistance.

Seventeen Daedric Princes rule Oblivion realms: Azura (Dusk & Dawn), Boethiah (Plots & Treason), Clavicus Vile (Bargains & Pacts), Hermaeus Mora (Forbidden Knowledge), Hircine (The Hunt & Beasts), Jyggalag (Order), Malacath (The Spurned & Curses), Mehrunes Dagon (Destruction & Ambition), Mephala (Lies & Secrets), Meridia (Living Energy & Light), Molag Bal (Domination & Enslavement), Namira (Ancient Decay), Nocturnal (Night & Shadows), Peryite (Pestilence & Natural Order), Sanguine (Debauchery & Revelry), Sheogorath (Madness), and Vaermina (Nightmares & Tortured Dreams). Cultists worship them at hidden shrines throughout Tamriel. They bestow powerful artifacts upon mortals in exchange for dangerous bargains.
The Fighters Guild offers mercenary contracts, beast extermination, escort security, and combat training throughout Tamriel. They maintain warrior halls in major provincial cities.
The Dark Brotherhood is a secretive syndicate of professional assassins worshipping Sithis and the Night Mother. They fulfill illegal contract killings across Tamriel.

The Morag Tong is the ancient guild of assassins legally sanctioned under Morrowind law. Operating under the sacred writs of Mephala and Dunmer Great House jurisdiction, they execute sanctioned blood feuds.

The Blades serve as the secret intelligence agency and bodyguards of the true Septim Emperors. Under Jagar Tharn's usurpation during the Imperial Simulacrum, the Blades have been hunted, infiltrated, or driven underground.

The Tribunal — Almalexia, Sotha Sil, and Vivec (ALMSIVI) — are the living gods ruling Morrowind during the Third Era from Mournhold, Clockwork City, and Vivec. Though actively worshipped by the Dunmer, their divine power is secretly waning as Dagoth Ur strengthens beneath Red Mountain.
